title: fixer's result
description: What the fixer writes as it ends, at <fix>/fixer.json: fixed, with each file it wrote, once it mended the problem that the orchestrator weighed; or a point that only the user or the orchestrator can settle.

result.description: The word it gives as it ends: fixed, once the deliverable is mended to the problem and what was already there still holds, confirmed the same way before the mend and after it; point, where the problem raises more than the orchestrator weighed, or its mend would change a decision of the user's.

point.description: With point: the point, with the fixer's recommendation and its ground, which the orchestrator weighs.

files.description: With fixed: each file it wrote, from the work's worktree's top.
